claims.assertion: Anéeka attributes many worldwide livestock mutilations to regressive groups including Maitré, tall Greys, Kingu, Orange, and Malakak.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She also alleges human government agents conduct some cases.

claims.assertion: She says mutilations supply tissues and genetic material for food, hybridization, cloning, and biointerface technologies.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She includes human and wild animals among targets.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says nonhuman groups collect plant genes to adapt organisms to unfamiliar atmospheres and temperatures.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She doubts this final practice occurs on Earth.
